body:
The owner, 2026-11-23 22:2x: "plan that kit step"; "shouldn't there be a resume specific to every role, with a need to know basis of what to read?". Goal: a session starts from `kit.py resume --role <orchestrator|part|clerk|review>` alone, with no reading list in its prompt.
- orchestrator: today's resume (trains, open questions, decisions, unanswered comments, attached boards), plus the launch workflow for its runtime (including a step on an attached board: launch from the train's repo clone, with no seeded local board and no auto-sync push to another repo's board-mirror), plus the lessons that apply to the orchestrator, plus the parts' context and save-point checks.
- part: its own post, its prompt, the lessons that touch its files, its test command, and how to report Done.
- clerk: the comment routing and the session ids only.
- review: the step, its acceptance conditions, and the real-project check.
Lessons move into the kit's memory, each one tagged with its roles. A lesson that lives only in a project's docs is refused. Example: Harmonize's lesson 51a in docs/ORCHESTRATION.md.
Also fix the gaps O53 hit tonight: `kit.py launch` from Harmonize finds no post for a step on the attached board (`repos/board/posts`); `launch_text` raises KeyError 'board'; a board server's auto-sync pushed seeded posts to anlonlt/board board-mirror.
Acceptance: a fresh orchestrator session, given only "run `kit.py resume --role orchestrator`", launches a cli-train step the kit way with no hand step. A part's acceptance includes a dry run on the real project (Harmonize), not only the kit's suite. Every orchestrator hand-over template drops its reading list.
title: resume per role: what each role needs, the lessons and the workflow included
